title: Hexagon
subtitle: Flat top, straight taper
description: A flat-topped hexagon: full width through the middle, tapering in a straight line to each edge.

The straight taper is the whole read. An arc of the same depth is a rounded rectangle, and the two are hard to tell apart in a small picture -- which is why the test for this shape asserts that the taper's steps are equal rather than merely that it narrows.
